articles.title: AlphaGenome 2: Teaching AI to read the entire human genome
articles.summary: 98% of human DNA doesn't build proteins—it controls how our cells work, and holds vital clues to why diseases happen and why 90% of new drugs fail in clinical trials. Understanding the genome at the molecular level is the key to deciphering the blueprint of human life.
body: In this episode, Professor Hannah Fry speaks with Google DeepMind's Žiga Avsec and Adam Gayoso about AlphaGenome, the AlphaGenome Atlas, and AlphaGenome 2—exploring how AI reads non-coding DNA down to single-cell resolution to pinpoint disease-causing mutations and help researchers solve medical mysteries.
